articles.summary: Yahoo Personal Finance: Gold and silver prices today, Wednesday, April 29: Prices tanking ahead of Fed meeting. Gold opened at $4,611.40 per troy ounce on Wednesday, and fell even further to $4,585 as of 6:36 a.m. ET. Silver opened at $72.98 per ounce on Wednesday, and was trading at $73.35 as of 6:36 a.m. ET. articles.title: WHX Bangkok and Medtec Southeast Asia 2026 to Position Thailand as the Gateway to ASEAN's Medical Market
articles.mainIdea: WHX Bangkok and Medtec Southeast Asia 2026 to Position Thailand as the Gateway to ASEAN's Medical Market
articles.summary: PR Newswire: WHX Bangkok and Medtec Southeast Asia 2026 to Position Thailand as the Gateway to ASEAN's Medical Market. From 8 to 10 July, Informa Markets will take the global stage, uniting over 950 exhibitors at International Healthcare Week and reinforcing Thailand's leadership in healthcare and medical manufacturing. The event will feature two major co-located exhibitions: WHX Bangkok and Medtec Southeast Asia 2026.
